senses.sense_definition: de mate waarin een omgeving of situatie geschikt is om prettig in te wonen of te verblijven

examples.text: De <w>leefbaarheid</w> van de buurt is de laatste jaren sterk verbeterd door nieuwe parken.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>livability</w> of the neighborhood has improved significantly in recent years due to new parks.

examples.text: De <w>leefbaarheid</w> in de wijk staat onder druk door de vele overlast van verkeer.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>livability</w> in the district is under pressure due to the significant nuisance from traffic.

target_lang_definitions.en: The degree to which an environment or situation is suitable for living or staying in comfortably.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The general quality of being suitable for living in.
The standard of health, comfort, and happiness experienced by individuals or groups.
